overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Arosa 4 Person Barrel Traditional Sauna offers a luxurious outdoor retreat designed for relaxation and wellness. Crafted from Pacific Premium Cedar wood, this sauna provides a spacious environment for up to four people, making it perfect for family use or social gatherings. With a temperature range reaching up to 190°F, it promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. The sauna features a bronze privacy tempered glass door and an interior LED control panel for accent lighting, ensuring both privacy and ambiance. Ideal for outdoor settings, the Arosa sauna combines traditional design with modern convenience, including a 6.0 kW stove with built-in controls and optional upgrades for enhanced performance.

Take the first step to a healthier life!
